meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 分析基因表达数据,推断哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因,输出每条调控关系及重要性分数,支持用GRNBoost2或GENIE3算法,可用Dask做分布式计算。
howto.when: 当用户提供转录组数据(如bulk RNA-seq、单细胞RNA-seq)并想找转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 用这份单细胞RNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
say.note: 运行GRNBoost2并输出调控关系表。

say.text: 跑GRNBoost2,过滤重要性大于0.5的连接
say.note: 只保留高置信度的调控关系。
同一份数据跑两种算法做比较。

howto.what_en: Analyzes gene expression data to infer which transcription factors regulate which target genes, outputs regulatory links with importance scores, using GRNBoost2 or GENIE3, and supports Dask-based distributed computation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) and asks to find transcription factor–target gene regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from this single-cell RNA-seq data.
say_en.note: Runs GRNBoost2 and returns the network.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 and filter links with importance above 0.5.
Compare GRNBoost2 and GENIE3 results on the same data.
